record.dic_text:
03610 kil'ayim {kil-ah'-yim}

03608 的雙數型,  原有"分開"之意; TWOT - 980d; 陽性名詞

AV - mingled seed 1, mingled 1, diverse kinds 1, diverse seeds 1; 4

1) 兩個種類, 混雜
   1a) 一種被禁止的行為, 諸如使不同種類的牲口雜交, 將不同種類的
       種子播種在一起, 或用不同種類的質料製作同一件衣服
record.edic_text:
03610 kil'ayim {kil-ah'-yim}

dual of 03608 in the original sense of separation; TWOT - 980d; n m

AV - mingled seed 1, mingled 1, diverse kinds 1, diverse seeds 1; 4

1) two kinds, mixture
   1a) forbidden practice among cattle (cross breeding), seeds
       (sowing), and cloth garments (material)
